business_summary.text: Asian Energy Services Limited provides end-to-end upstream oil & gas services and mineral services, with operations spanning exploration, development, and production. The company is in the process of merging with Oilmax to strengthen its integrated energy platform.

call_points.text: FY27 guidance maintained for both Asian Energy Services and Kuiper
Oilmax production target of ~10,000 BOPD by FY29/FY30 from current ~2,500 BOPD
Oilmax operating at >50% EBITDA margin with ~US$ 5/bbl production cost
Merger with Oilmax to strengthen balance sheet and add upstream assets
Volatile Middle East situation as a key risk to operations
FY27 standalone top-line growth is guided at 30% to 40%.
Total capex commitment for FY27 on block level is around ₹100 crores, with Asian's share at ₹50 crores.
Order book stands at approximately ₹1,750 crores, excluding taxes and Kuiper.
Consolidated EBITDA margins for FY27 are expected to be around 12% to 13%.

operating_notes.text: Company raised ₹92.03 Cr via warrant conversion and ₹39 Cr upfront, totaling ₹131.03 Cr raised since November 5, 2024.
Recommended final dividend of ₹1.25 per equity share for FY25-26.
Order book at approximately ₹1,750 crores as of FY26 end excluding taxes and Kuiper.
Order book of ₹1,754 Cr provides 2-3 years of revenue visibility
Robust bid pipeline of ₹3,000-4,000 Cr for future tenders
Oilmax Energy executed Revenue Sharing Contract for Contract Area GK/OSDSF/GKOSN/2025 under DSF Bid Round-IV with 50% participating interest as Operator.

timeline.summary: Asian Energy Services withdrew India Ratings coverage on its ₹125 Cr bank facilities.
Oilmax Energy Private Limited and Mrs. Ritu Garg, promoters, declared no encumbrances on Asian Energy Services Limited’s shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI regulations.
CRISIL enhanced Asian Energy Services' total rated bank facilities to ₹317.5 Cr while maintaining ratings on watch with developing implications.
Asian Energy Services allotted 36.63 lakh equity shares upon conversion of warrants, raising ₹92.03 Cr, while 10.37 lakh warrants lapsed.
Asian Energy completed the conversion of 36.62 lakh warrants, raising ₹92.03 Cr.
Asian Energy Services scheduled a court-convened general meeting of equity shareholders for June 12, 2026, pursuant to an NCLT order regarding the proposed merger with Oilmax Energy.
Asian Energy Services filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, confirming no deviation in preferential issue proceeds utilization.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹338.23 Cr (+57.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹31.96 Cr (+41.9% YoY).
Asian Energy reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹338.23 Cr and net profit of ₹32.65 Cr, recommending a dividend of ₹1.25 per share.
Asian Energy Services Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call held on 20th May 2026 at 05:00 PM (IST) on its website.
On May 26, 2026, Asian Energy Services filed the transcript of its Q4 & FY26 earnings conference call held on May 20, 2026.
Asian Energy Services empanelled by Oil India for on-land seismic data acquisition

Asian Energy Services Limited’s management, led by **Shweta Jain** and **Vaibhav Jain**, scheduled an analysts/investors meet on **Friday, June 12, 2026, at 04:00 PM (virtual)** under SEBI’s Regulation 30.

Asian Energy Services Limited reported Q1FY27 results with 135% YoY revenue growth to ₹271.2 Cr, secured a ₹187.6 Cr order from GSECL, and provided an update on the Oilmax merger timeline with NCLT hearing scheduled for 28th August 2026.
Asian Energy received the NCLT Mumbai Bench final order for the merger by absorption of Oilmax Energy on October 15, 2026.
Oilmax Energy executed the Revenue Sharing Contract for Contract Area GK/OSDSF/GKOSN/2025 under DSF Bid Round-IV ahead of its absorption merger into Asian Energy Services.
Asian Energy Services Limited invites analysts to earnings conference call on Friday 30th October 2026 at 6:00 PM IST.
